source: https://wiki.biligame.com/dsp/采矿机 (30/min per vein, official text)

mining.miningSpeedMultiplierFormula: miningSpeedMultiplier = 1 + 0.10 * VeinUtilizationLevel (applies to Mining Machine, Advanced Mining Machine, Water Pump, Oil Extractor and Orbital Collector gathering speed)
mining.veinConsumptionFormula: vein units consumed per item = 0.94 ^ VeinUtilizationLevel; total ore obtainable from a vein = initialAmount / 0.94^level

prefabPeriodFactor.note: rate = 60 / periodf items per minute per vein (MinerDesc.periodf); reproduces 30 / 60 / 50 / oilfield-rate exactly

mining.oilExtractorRate: crude oil seep base production rate (displayed in-game, per second, minimum 0.1/s = 6/min) * miningSpeedMultiplier; seep rate decays with a 12 h half-life while extracting
mining.waterPumpRate: 50 items/min * miningSpeedMultiplier (also pumps Sulfuric Acid from acid oceans)

orbitalCollectorRates.formula: raw rate = gas giant base yield * 8 * miningSpeedMultiplier
orbitalCollectorRates.consumption: the 30 MW upkeep is paid from the collected Hydrogen/Deuterium/Fire Ice (9 MJ per H2/D2, 4.8 MJ per Fire Ice), so about 200 units/min are consumed; net output = raw - upkeep

mining.notes: Vein Utilization adds +10% mining speed additively per level and reduces vein consumption by 6% compounding per level, so total available ore rises as 1/0.94^n while the depletion rate peaks at level 6 and falls below the level-0 rate at level 17. The rate is the SAME for every material vein type (both the EN and the zh-CN wiki state this explicitly). CONFLICT: VeinProtoSet.MiningTime differs per ore (stone 45, coal 30, iron/copper/silicon/titanium/crude 60, kimberlite/fractal/grating/stalagmite 90, unipolar magnet 120); if the machine used it the rates would differ, so MiningTime is judged to drive hand-mining / mecha mining rather than machine throughput - chosen: flat 30/min/vein. Miners covering more than 1800/min auto-stack their output (2 stacks at >1800/min, 3 at >3600/min, 4 at >5400/min).

belts.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.I
belts.note: game: BeltDesc.speed=1 with a 6 items/s base; one item per tile plus one per tile joint; Automatic Piler can stack up to 4

sorters.name: Sorter Mk.I
sorters.note: sttf=1/3 s per trip per grid; rate = 0.5/sttf; wiki lists filtering on every sorter Mk (the Sorters page says Mk.I/Mk.II/Mk.III can all take filters)

cargoStackingWithUpgrade.conflict: UNRESOLVED: the 5-level "Sorter Cargo Stacking" chain (protoset values 4,5,6,7,8) is IsObsolete=true in 0.10.35 and was replaced by "Pile Sorter Upgrade" (3311-3316: unload 2, load 3, unload 3, load 4, unload 4, maximised). The wiki Transport-Rate table (2..6 -> 12..36 items/s) was written against the obsolete chain. Chosen: wiki values 12/18/24/30/36 items/s, because the wiki and the GameData-rendered infobox agree with each other, but treat live 0.10.x sorter stacking as UNCONFIRMED.

notes: Sorter speed is quoted at 1 grid of reach; it halves for 2 grids and is one third at 3 grids (maximum reach = 3 tiles). Sorter Cargo Stacking (5 levels) multiplies Sorter Mk.III throughput: chosen values are the wiki stack sizes 2/3/4/5/6 => 12/18/24/30/36 items/s, because both the wiki Transport-Rate table and the GameData-rendered infobox agree; the protoset per-level UnlockValues (4,5,6,7,8) disagree and are recorded as an open conflict. Pile Sorter = 0.05 s/grid (20 trips/s, base stack 2). Belt/sorter item ids 2001-2003 and 2011-2014 are confirmed by both Modding:Items_IDs and BeltDesc.beltPrototype in the game prefabs.
